what_it_checks: Degenerate constant-baseline exponential-budget conversion and nanosecond rounding for every family.
derivation: With X=1, rate=1 and base_mean_s=1, section 4.2 gives delta_seconds=g. For U=exp(-1), g=-ln(U)=1. The integer-nanosecond conversion is ceil(1*1e9)=1,000,000,000, so all four families resolve the same parent timestamp before their family-specific dynamics matter.
